rounds.q: What % of the world's people have electricity?
rounds.why: About 666 million people still live without it. 85% of them are in sub-Saharan Africa.
rounds.src: Tracking SDG7: The Energy Progress Report 2025 (2023 data)
rounds.fun: Most of us just flip a switch, but 666 million people are still waiting for the lights.

rounds.q: What % of the world's babies got all 3 doses of their basic vaccine?
rounds.why: That's about 109 million babies. Still, 14.3 million got no vaccines at all.
rounds.fun: About 109 million babies got all 3 doses. Tiny humans, big protection!

rounds.q: What % of the world's adults can read and write?
rounds.why: That still leaves 739 million adults who can't. Two thirds of them are women.
rounds.fun: 88 out of 100 grown-ups can read and write. High five, fellow readers!

rounds.q: How long does the average person on Earth live?
rounds.why: COVID pulled it down to 70.9 in 2020 and 2021. It has fully bounced back.
rounds.fun: COVID knocked it down to 70.9, but it bounced right back like a rubber ball!

rounds.q: What % of the world's people live in cities?
rounds.why: In 1950, it was about 30%. Most of the growth now is in Africa and Asia.
rounds.src: World Bank (2024); UN World Urbanization Prospects
rounds.fun: From about 30% in 1950 to 58% now. Cities nearly doubled their share. Big city energy!
